en.headline: HKMA proposes lower capital charges for loans to Northern Metropolis university towns
en.dek: The authority plans to designate 11 post-secondary institutions and three park companies as domestic public sector entities, with legislative amendments targeted for early next year.
body: The Hong Kong Monetary Authority said on Tuesday it would propose amendments to the Banking (Capital) Rules to ease financing for Northern Metropolis projects.

Under the plan, 11 post-secondary institutions and three park companies would be designated as Domestic Public Sector Entities, giving them preferential risk-weighting treatment and lowering banks’ capital costs when lending to them.

The Northern Metropolis Financial Advisory Taskforce, jointly set up by the HKMA and the Hong Kong Association of Banks, held its third meeting on Tuesday. The Education Bureau briefed participants on the three university towns in San Tin, Hung Shui Kiu and Ta Kwu Ling.

The HKMA intends to submit the amendments to the Legislative Council in the first quarter of 2027 so they can take effect in the second quarter. Participating banks expressed support for financing the university towns and surrounding industry projects.

zh.headline: 金管局擬修訂資本規則 降低北都大學城貸款資金成本
zh.dek: 當局建議將11間專上院校及三間園區公司指定為本地公營單位，修訂案擬於2027年第一季提交立法會，第二季生效。
body: 香港金融管理局周二表示，建議修訂《銀行業（資本）規則》，以降低銀行對北部都會區項目的資金成本，加速落實相關發展。
根據建議，11間專上院校及三間園區公司將被指定為「本地公營單位」，在標準化信用風險框架下獲得較優惠的風險權重待遇，協助它們更容易取得銀行融資。
由金管局與香港銀行公會共同成立的北部都會區金融諮詢工作小組周二舉行第三次會議，教育局介紹了新田、洪水橋及打鼓嶺三個大學城的最新發展及財務安排。
金管局擬於2027年第一季向立法會提交修訂案，以期同年第二季生效。參與銀行表示會提供合適金融服務，支持大學城與周邊產業園區協同發展。
